tasks.title: Add environment variable validation at startup
tasks.description: Implement startup validation to ensure NOTION_API_KEY and NOTION_DATABASE_ID environment variables are configured before any operations execute. This prevents runtime failures due to missing configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Check NOTION_API_KEY is set and non-empty at module initialization
Check NOTION_DATABASE_ID is set and non-empty at module initialization
Throw ConfigurationError with clear message if any required variable is missing
Prevent any Notion API operations if validation fails
Validation executes before notion client initialization

technical_details.execution_point: Top of module, before notion client creation
technical_details.error_handling: Throw ConfigurationError with missing variable names

tasks.implementation_notes: This is the highest priority task as it prevents silent failures and provides immediate feedback on configuration issues.

tasks.title: Add comprehensive custom error types
tasks.description: Create custom error classes for different failure scenarios (API errors, validation errors, configuration errors) to improve error handling, debugging, and error recovery logic throughout the codebase.
acceptance_criteria: NotionAPIError class extends Error with API-specific context
ValidationError class extends Error for input validation failures
ConfigurationError class extends Error for environment/config issues
Each error class includes helpful context (operation, parameters, original error)
Error classes are used consistently throughout codebase
tasks.implementation_notes: Implement before other tasks to enable better error handling in subsequent implementations.

tasks.title: Add input validation for task creation
tasks.description: Implement validation for createTask function inputs before making API calls. Validate title is non-empty, check parameter types, and enforce any business rules for task data.
acceptance_criteria: Validate title parameter is string and non-empty
Validate title length (max 2000 characters per Notion limits)
Validate assignedTo is string if provided
Validate notes is string if provided
Throw ValidationError with specific field and reason for failures
Validation executes before API call
tasks.implementation_notes: Use ValidationError from TASK-002 for consistent error handling.

tasks.title: Add input validation for task updates
tasks.description: Implement validation for updateTask function inputs including page ID format validation and status value validation.
acceptance_criteria: Validate pageId is valid UUID format
Validate status is one of allowed values
Validate notes is string if provided
Throw ValidationError for invalid inputs
Validation executes before API call

validation_rules: pageId: required, valid UUID v4 format
status: required, string, valid status value

tasks.implementation_notes: Status values should match Notion database status property configuration.

tasks.title: Add retry logic with exponential backoff
tasks.description: Implement retry wrapper for API calls to handle transient failures. Use exponential backoff strategy with configurable retry attempts. Distinguish between retryable and non-retryable errors.
acceptance_criteria: Retry failed API calls up to 3 times (configurable)
Use exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s between retries
Only retry on transient errors (network, timeout, 500-series)
Do not retry on permanent errors (401, 403, 404, 400)
Log each retry attempt with context
Throw appropriate error after max retries exceeded

patterns: Higher-order function wrapper for async operations

tasks.implementation_notes: Apply withRetry wrapper to all Notion API calls (createTask, updateTask, future query operations).

tasks.title: Add task retrieval functionality
tasks.description: Implement functions to query and retrieve tasks from Notion database. Support retrieving all tasks, single task by ID, and paginated results.
acceptance_criteria: getTasks() function retrieves all tasks from database
getTaskById(pageId) function retrieves single task
Handle pagination for large result sets (>100 tasks)
Return structured task data with all properties
Handle API errors using NotionAPIError
Apply retry logic to API calls

technical_details.response_processing: Parse Notion API response format into simplified task objects

tasks.implementation_notes: This is a critical foundation task that unblocks multiple filtering and query features.

tasks.title: Add database schema validation
tasks.description: Implement validation to verify Notion database has required properties with correct types. This ensures the database structure matches what the code expects.
acceptance_criteria: Retrieve database schema using notion.databases.retrieve
Validate presence of required properties: Task, Assigned To, Status, Notes, ID
Validate property types match expectations (title, people, status, rich_text, number)
Throw ConfigurationError if schema mismatch detected
Provide detailed error message indicating missing/incorrect properties
Can be called as health check function
tasks.implementation_notes: Should be called during initialization or as explicit health check. Critical for preventing runtime errors.

tasks.title: Add task filtering by status
tasks.description: Implement filtering capability to retrieve tasks based on their status value (To-do, In Progress, Done, etc.). Uses Notion database query filters.
acceptance_criteria: getTasksByStatus(status) function filters by status
Supports all valid status values in database
Returns empty array if no matches found
Handles pagination for large filtered result sets
Applies retry logic and error handling
tasks.implementation_notes: Requires TASK-006 completion for base query functionality.

tasks.title: Add task filtering by assignee
tasks.description: Implement filtering capability to retrieve tasks assigned to specific people. Should support filtering by person and retrieving unassigned tasks.
acceptance_criteria: getTasksByAssignee(personName) function filters by assignee
getUnassignedTasks() function retrieves tasks with no assignee
Handles Notion people property format correctly
Returns empty array if no matches found
Applies retry logic and error handling
tasks.implementation_notes: Note that current implementation sets people to empty array, so filtering may need refinement based on actual usage.

tasks.title: Add task filtering by date range
tasks.description: Implement filtering capability to retrieve tasks based on creation date, last edited date, or custom date properties.
acceptance_criteria: getTasksByDateRange(startDate, endDate, dateProperty) function filters by date
Supports filtering by created_time, last_edited_time, or custom date properties
Validates date parameters are valid Date objects or ISO strings
Returns tasks within inclusive date range
Applies retry logic and error handling
tasks.implementation_notes: Consider adding date validation as part of TASK-003/TASK-004 validation enhancements.

tasks.title: Add task archiving functionality
tasks.description: Implement function to archive tasks in Notion. Notion doesn't support true deletion, but allows archiving pages which removes them from default queries.
acceptance_criteria: archiveTask(pageId) function archives a task by page ID
Archived tasks are no longer visible in default database queries
Validates pageId before making API call
Operation can be reversed by setting archived to false
Logs operation success/failure appropriately
Applies retry logic and error handling
tasks.implementation_notes: Simple implementation but useful for task lifecycle management.

tasks.title: Add rate limit handling
tasks.description: Implement rate limit detection and handling to prevent API quota exhaustion. Detect 429 responses from Notion API and implement appropriate backoff strategy.
acceptance_criteria: Detect 429 Too Many Requests responses from Notion API
Extract retry-after header if present
Implement exponential backoff with max wait time (60s)
Log rate limit events with timestamp and retry delay
Resume operations after cooldown period
Integrate with existing retry logic from TASK-005
tasks.implementation_notes: Requires TASK-005 retry logic as foundation. Should respect retry-after header from Notion API.

tasks.title: Add batch task creation operations
tasks.description: Implement function to create multiple tasks in a single operation for efficiency. Handle partial failures gracefully and return results for each task.
acceptance_criteria: createTasksBatch(tasks[]) function creates multiple tasks
Each task in array validated before processing
Operations execute in parallel using Promise.allSettled
Return array of results indicating success/failure for each task
Handle partial failures without stopping entire batch
Apply retry logic to each individual operation
Log batch summary (total, successful, failed)

patterns: Promise.allSettled for parallel operations with failure isolation
technical_details.input_format: Array of task objects {title, assignedTo, notes}

tasks.implementation_notes: Consider batch size limits and memory constraints for very large batches.

tasks.title: Add batch task update operations
tasks.description: Implement function to update multiple tasks in a single operation. Support updating status and notes for multiple tasks efficiently.
acceptance_criteria: updateTasksBatch(updates[]) function updates multiple tasks
Each update validated before processing
Operations execute in parallel using Promise.allSettled
Return array of results for each update operation
Handle partial failures gracefully
Apply retry logic to each operation
Log batch summary statistics

technical_details.input_format: Array of update objects {pageId, status, notes}

tasks.implementation_notes: Mirror createTasksBatch implementation pattern for consistency.

tasks.title: Enhance documentation with comprehensive usage guide
tasks.description: Create comprehensive documentation including setup instructions, API reference, usage examples for all functions, troubleshooting guide, and best practices.
acceptance_criteria: README includes installation instructions
README documents all environment variables
README includes Notion database setup guide
All functions documented with parameters, return values, examples
Error handling scenarios documented
Troubleshooting section for common issues
Code examples for all major use cases
tasks.implementation_notes: Should be completed after all major features are implemented to ensure accuracy and completeness.
